size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the get-user controller, which the prompt points at by naming GET /v1/users/:userId and contrasting it with endpoints that serialize correctly.
prompt: GET /v1/users/:userId returns the raw database record, with `_id`, `__v`, `createdAt`/`updatedAt` and the hashed `password`, instead of the cleaned-up user object that GET /v1/users and PATCH /v1/users/:userId return.

root_cause.detail: getUser sends user.toObject(), which bypasses the schema's toJSON transform (id mapping, private-field and timestamp removal), leaking _id, __v, timestamps and the password hash.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users/:userId > should return 200 and the user object if data is ok
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should return 200 and the user object if data is ok'
